name: SportMonks Football
description: SportMonks Football API v3: leagues, seasons, fixtures and results, livescores, standings, top scorers, teams, squads, players, venues, pre-match odds and predictions, with SportMonks include and filter syntax. Coverage depends on your SportMonks plan.
instructions:
## SportMonks Football
This connector reads the SportMonks Football API v3 (`https://api.sportmonks.com/v3`): leagues and seasons, fixtures and results, livescores, standings, top scorers, teams and squads, players, venues, pre-match odds and predictions. Every tool only reads.

**Setup.** Sign in at https://my.sportmonks.com, open API, create an API token and paste it into `SPORTMONKS_API_TOKEN`. It is sent in the `Authorization` header. A free plan exists (a few leagues); paid plans add leagues and add-ons such as odds and predictions.

**Plan coverage.** Data outside your plan does not raise an error: the answer is empty with the message "No result(s) found ... you don't have access to it via your current subscription". Call `sportmonks_list_my_leagues` first and work with those leagues. Odds and predictions need the matching add-on.

**Includes.** Base answers only carry ids. Ask for related data with `include`, separated by semicolons and nested with dots: `participants;scores;state;events.type;lineups.player`. Ids such as `type_id`, `state_id` or `position_id` are explained by adding `.type` (or `state`, `position`) to the include, or by `sportmonks_list_types`. Each tool lists useful includes. Keep includes to what you need: they make answers much larger.

**Filters, fields and paging.** `filters` takes SportMonks filters separated by semicolons, e.g. `fixtureLeagues:9` on fixture lists, `eventTypes:14,15` on events, `markets:1;bookmakers:2` on odds (`sportmonks_get_prematch_odds`), `seasonTopscorerTypes:208` on top scorers. `select` returns only the fields you list. Lists are paged (`per_page` up to 50); when `pagination.has_more` is true, call again with the next `page`.

**Ids.** League ids: 8 Premier League, 9 Championship, 82 Bundesliga, 384 Serie A, 564 LaLiga, 301 Ligue 1, 2 Champions League. The standings, top scorer and squad tools take a season id: get it from `sportmonks_get_league` with include `currentSeason`. Fixture lists give fixture ids for the match, odds and prediction tools. For one market of a fixture use `sportmonks_get_prematch_odds_by_market` (market ids from `sportmonks_list_odds_markets`), for one bookmaker `sportmonks_get_prematch_odds_by_bookmaker` (ids from `sportmonks_list_bookmakers`); both are smaller than the full odds list. Teams and players: use the search tools.

**Reading the data.** Times are UTC unless you pass `timezone`. `result_info` is a sentence such as "Arsenal won after full-time."; scores are in the `scores` include (`description` CURRENT is the latest score). Odds values are decimal.

**Rate limit.** 3,000 calls per hour per entity (fixtures, teams, players ...). Every answer carries `rate_limit.remaining` and `resets_in_seconds`; on 429 wait until the reset. Prefer one list call with a filter over many single calls.
prerequisites: A SportMonks account with an API token (free plan or paid). The leagues, odds and predictions you can read depend on the plan.

SPORTMONKS_API_TOKEN.label: API token
SPORTMONKS_API_TOKEN.help: In my.sportmonks.com open API, then Tokens, create a token and paste it here.
SPORTMONKS_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces or an api_token= prefix.

verifyHints.401: SportMonks refused the token. Create a new one at my.sportmonks.com under API and paste it again.
verifyHints.403: The token works but this resource is not in your SportMonks plan.
verifyHints.429: SportMonks allows 3,000 calls per hour per entity. Wait for the reset and try again.
